selector.champion: Peeling skin disease due to CDSN gene mutations
selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms and skin biopsy findings, including complete separation of the stratum corneum and mild psoriasiform hyperplasia, along with the genetic study revealing 2 heterozygous mutations in exon 2 of the CDSN gene, strongly support this diagnosis.
